changedAssetMetadata.prompt: Edit original photo only: red cushion to blue, blue vase to purple, yellow clock to blue, green cup to red, orange closed book cover to green with pages unchanged, remove only right apple leaving left apple and white plate. Preserve exact people identity, hands, clothes, room, camera, lighting and all other objects. No glyphs, annotations or added icons.

verification.method: Visual inspection of original and generated changed image; pixel-exact identity outside edits is not asserted.

assetMetadata.prompt: Natural near-photorealistic East Asian mother and primary-school daughter reading closely on beige sofa in sunny living room. Six clear targets: red cushion left, blue vase front-left, yellow round clock upper-right shelf, green cup front-center, orange closed book front-center-right, white plate with exactly two red apples front-right. 1536x1024 opaque landscape. No UI, labels, logos, readable text or cartoon humans.
